method.pixelObservation: Opened each records.screenshot exactly once with functions.view_image in this fresh context. Independently inspected the full-page pixels for visible entry coverage, typography, rendered math structure, line wrapping, overlap, clipping, figure boundaries and standards input affordances. Stored DOM evidence supported but did not replace these observations.
method.hashVerification: Read bytes locally for SHA-256 and byte-count verification only; PNG header dimensions were read without decoding or displaying images. Native HTML, exercises and answer-key files were hash-bound only, not semantically re-reviewed.
method.verdictMeaning: pass means no actionable display defect observed in this screenshot at the provided review resolution. It does not certify source fidelity, historical glyph identity, mathematical correctness, answer correctness, publishing readiness or whole-course acceptance.

automaticToolResize.observation: The view_image tool reported this automatic resize. No crop, manual resize, screenshot or reopen was requested. All eleven entry numbers, visible prose, math structures and the complete figure remained discernible; exact per-glyph raster fidelity is not certified.

bindingVerification.verificationPurpose: Evidence integrity only; byte equality is not source, science, glyph or answer approval.

limitations: This is a one-load, full-page screenshot review. No crops, zoomed alternate payloads, reopens, browser interaction or recaptures were used.
The longest screenshot was automatically resized by view_image from 390x6058 to 386x6000. Its visible layout remained reviewable; exact per-glyph raster fidelity is not certified.

KaTeX completeness is limited to visible rendered structure and absence of observed broken or missing math. Stored DOM math counts of 25 for written and 60 for standards are supporting evidence, not a claim that every individual glyph was independently verified.
Read-only is a visible-affordance judgment: zero visible answer inputs or submission controls. Interactive behavior, focus states and hidden controls were not tested.
Figure completeness describes its displayed extents, labels and components in these screenshots only, not correspondence to original figure-source pixels.
Native render and DOM PASS are reused from the isolated D678 evidence. This report is not a new live-app acceptance run or whole-course approval.
